results.title: Abhishek Sharma becomes T20’s new six-hitting star, eyes Rohit Sharma’s all-time record
results.description: Young India opener creates history with 100 T20I sixes and is now closing in on Virat Kohli and Hardik Pandya's milestones Abhishek Sharma has rapidly established himself as one of the most dangerous batters in T20 cricket. The aggressive left-handed opener from Punjab has built a reputation for fearless stroke play and effortless six-hitting, making him one of India's biggest match-winners in the shortest format. Although Abhishek could not make a big impact during the recent T20I series against Zimbabwe, he still managed to create history by achieving a major milestone in international cricket. At just 25 years of age, Abhishek has completed 100 sixes in T20 Internationals, becoming one of the fastest players to reach the landmark. He has now smashed 104 sixes in only 55 innings, surpassing the previous record held by West Indies power-hitter Evin Lewis. His remarkable strike rate and ability to clear the boundary consistently have earned him the reputation of being one of the finest six-hitters in world cricket. With 104 T20I sixes to his name, Abhishek has also entered the prestigious 100-sixes club. He has become the 43rd player in the world to score 100 or more sixes in T20 International cricket. Among Indian players, he has also climbed into the top four for most T20I sixes. On average, Abhishek is hitting three to four sixes in every match, underlining his dominance as a power hitter. Also Read: Tilak Varma emerges as team India's No.3 solution, management pins hopes on T20 future The left-handed opener is now within touching distance of two more major Indian records. Hardik Pandya currently occupies second place among India's highest T20I six-hitters with 126 sixes, while Virat Kohli is third with 124 sixes. If Abhishek continues his current form, he has a strong chance of overtaking both during the upcoming T20 International series. His consistency over the last year has been equally impressive. During the 2025-26 season, Abhishek played 22 T20I innings and smashed 36 sixes. His most productive opposition was New Zealand, against whom he struck 18 sixes, the highest against any team during that period. So far this year, Abhishek has featured in only 10 T20 International matches. Even with limited appearances, he has already hit eight sixes, suggesting there is plenty of room for that tally to grow as more matches are played. Also Read: Mission 2027 begins: Gambhir, Gill and BCCI draw up India's World Cup master plan Looking further ahead, the young batter could be in line to challenge one of the biggest records in T20 cricket before the 2028 T20 World Cup. Former India captain Rohit Sharma currently leads the all-time T20 International six-hitting chart with 205 sixes. If Abhishek maintains his current scoring rate over the next few years, he could emerge as a serious contender to break that record as well. Abhishek Sharma has already transformed himself into one of the most explosive batters in T20 cricket. Hitting sixes has become a trademark of his batting, and with age on his side, the Indian opener appears well placed to add many more records to his name in the years ahead.

results.title: Trump revives debate over California's Sable pipeline project amid pushback from Newsom, West Coast governors
results.description: US President Donald Trump renewed debate over California's Sable Pipeline project, highlighting an executive order to boost offshore oil production. results.title: Bankipur, Datia election result LIVE: Key test for Prashant Kishor in Bihar, counting of votes begins at 8am
results.description: Bankipur, Datia election result LIVE: Counting of votes for the bypolls in three assembly constituencies, Bankipur, Datia and Manjalpur, will begin at 8am today.
